Signed lower-degree products justify differentiated background factors. The nonvanishing telescoping form has exactly degree n-1 and its sum stops at m-q-1. These proofs supply the continuous product/domination inputs in 604 without circular use of their own construction; general bounded products and continuity remain outside the scope.

Smooth proper existence and approximation precede products; envelopes precede nonvanishing/domination; uniform stability and continuous regularity follow them.
